notchTaskboxDescription: Float AI session status, task progress, authorization prompts, and quick replies at the top of the screen. Enabling it turns off Desktop Pet.
notchTaskboxHardwareNotchDescription: Reserves the center area on MacBook displays so compact text is not covered by the physical notch.
notchTaskboxUpdateFailed: Failed to update Notch Taskbox settings
notchTaskboxHardwareNotchUpdateFailed: Failed to update screen notch adaptation
desktopPetUpdateFailed: Failed to update Desktop Pet settings
desktopPetDisabledByNotchTaskbox: Desktop Pet turns off automatically while Notch Taskbox is enabled
dndDescription: Pet stays idle, ignores AI events
confirmBubbleDescription: When off, AI tool authorizations stay in the main chat window
desktopOnly: Desktop Pet is only available in the desktop application. It cannot be used in WebUI browser mode.
